dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、いつも特別教室棟の屋上でお昼を
食べてるって、萌先輩が言ってたっけ。
dialogues.en:
I remember Moe-sempai telling me that they always eat lunch
out on the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
I remember Moe-sempai telling me that they always eat lunch
out on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
せっかくフリーパスを許されたんだ。無下にし
ては、もったいない。
dialogues.en: She did invite me, I might as well go there.
dialogues.text: She did invite me, I might as well go there.

dialogues.jp: 「そうと決まれば、早いとこ移動しよう」
dialogues.en: "As a matter of fact, I'm going to go now."
dialogues.text: "As a matter of fact, I'm going to go now."

dialogues.jp: この場所に、長居は無用だ。
dialogues.en: No need for me to stay here any longer.
dialogues.text: No need for me to stay here any longer.

dialogues.jp: 俺は眞子を追って廊下に出る。
dialogues.en: I followed Mako and went out to the hallway.
dialogues.text: I followed Mako and went out to the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりと歩く俺の横を、食堂組みが走り抜け
ていく。渡り廊下を通り教員棟に｛たど／辿｝り着くと、
下ではなく馴染みのない上階へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
As I walk slowly down the hall, other students heading
toward the cafeteria passed by me. I walked through the
breezeway to the teachers' building and climbed up the
stairs.
dialogues.text:
As I walk slowly down the hall, other students heading
toward the cafeteria passed by me. I walked through the
breezeway to the teachers' building and climbed up the
stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　いないや」
dialogues.en: "Huh? They're not here."
dialogues.text: "Huh? They're not here."

dialogues.jp:
時間が早かったのか、屋上には誰もいなかった。
確か、眞子のやつが先に教室を出て行ったハズ
なのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps I was too early. No one else is here on the rooftop.
I thought Mako left the classroom before me......
dialogues.text:
Perhaps I was too early. No one else is here on the rooftop.
I thought Mako left the classroom before me......

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そのうち来るだろう。とりあえず、身
　の安全を確保できたことを喜ぼう」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'm sure they'll be here soon. I'll just secure my
space for now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'm sure they'll be here soon. I'll just secure my
space for now."

dialogues.jp:
さくらも少しは成長してるかと思ったら、外見
も内面も全く変わってないし……こうなると、
逃げの一手しかない。
dialogues.en:
I expected Sakura to be more mature, but nothing has
changed, on the outside or on the inside...... I just have
to keep my distance from her.
dialogues.text:
I expected Sakura to be more mature, but nothing has
changed, on the outside or on the inside...... I just have
to keep my distance from her.

dialogues.jp:
付属の屋上では、あいつに見つかるかも知れな
いが、まさかこの俺が職員室の上にいるとは思
うまい。
dialogues.en:
She might find me on the other side of the building, but
she'll never think that I'm in the teachers' building.
dialogues.text:
She might find me on the other side of the building, but
she'll never think that I'm in the teachers' building.

dialogues.jp: 「フッ……敵の裏をかくのは、戦術の基本よ」
dialogues.en:
"Hah...... Outwitting the enemy's the basic rule in a
fight."
dialogues.text:
"Hah...... Outwitting the enemy's the basic rule in a
fight."

dialogues.jp: 誰もいない屋上で、一人勝利の余韻に浸る。
dialogues.en: I was in my foolish paradise.
dialogues.text: I was in my foolish paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「不気味……」
dialogues.en: "Strange......"
dialogues.text: "Strange......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ！？」
dialogues.en: "Wow!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あぁっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Kyaa!!"
dialogues.text: "Kyaa!!"

dialogues.jp: とっさに横に飛びのき、声のした方に構える。
dialogues.en: I jumped and looked toward the voice.
dialogues.text: I jumped and looked toward the voice.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょっと！　急になによ。ビックリす
　るじゃない！」
dialogues.en: "Hey! What's your problem! You scared me!"
dialogues.text: "Hey! What's your problem! You scared me!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、眞子か……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's you, Mako......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's you, Mako......"

dialogues.jp: 絶妙なタイミングで声をかけおって。
dialogues.en: She spoke to me with the weirdest timing.
dialogues.text: She spoke to me with the weirdest timing.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、ごめんなさい。驚かせてしまったみた
　いですね……」
dialogues.en: "Umm, I'm sorry. I guess we scared you......"
dialogues.text: "Umm, I'm sorry. I guess we scared you......"

dialogues.jp:
一人、穏やかな萌先輩が、ぺこりと頭を下げる。
この人は……どうやら驚かなかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai calmly bowed toward me. I guess she didn't get
scared.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai calmly bowed toward me. I guess she didn't get
scared.

dialogues.jp: 「……いえ……大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "......Oh, I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "......Oh, I'm fine."

dialogues.jp: 俺は構えを解き、ふたりの元に歩み寄る。
dialogues.en: I relaxed and walked closer toward them.
dialogues.text: I relaxed and walked closer toward them.

dialogues.jp:
「どこにいたんだ？　俺より先に出て行ったは
　ずなのに」
dialogues.en: "Where were you? I thought you left before me."
dialogues.text: "Where were you? I thought you left before me."

dialogues.jp: なぜか板を持っている眞子に声をかける。
dialogues.en:
I asked Mako, while she held a piece of board for some
reason.
dialogues.text:
I asked Mako, while she held a piece of board for some
reason.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「先に……って、あんた頃合を計ってたんじゃ」
dialogues.en: "What......? Are you stalking me or something?"
dialogues.text: "What......? Are you stalking me or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、お前が教室を出て行くときに会っただ
　ろうが」
dialogues.en:
"No, but we saw each other when we were leaving the
classroom, remember?"
dialogues.text:
"No, but we saw each other when we were leaving the
classroom, remember?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　そう言えば……」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Maybe we did......"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Maybe we did......"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が記憶を辿るように呟く。
dialogues.en: She murmured as she searched her mind.
dialogues.text: She murmured as she searched her mind.

dialogues.jp: まあ、のんびり歩いてきたのも確かだが……。
dialogues.en:
I do admit that I walked here slowly so that she would get
here first......
dialogues.text:
I do admit that I walked here slowly so that she would get
here first......

dialogues.jp: 「で、何してたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what took you so long?"
dialogues.text: "So, what took you so long?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……テーブルとかを取りに行ってたの」
dialogues.en: "...... I went and got the table and stuff."
dialogues.text: "...... I went and got the table and stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「テーブル？」
dialogues.en: "The table?"
dialogues.text: "The table?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そこの壁の陰に、置いているんです」
dialogues.en: "We keep it by the wall over there."
dialogues.text: "We keep it by the wall over there."

dialogues.jp:
そうか、そのデカイ板は昨日のテーブルだった
のか。そう言えば、萌先輩も手にコンロを持っ
てるし。
dialogues.en:
I realized that the board Mako's holding is the table from
yesterday. Moe-sempai also has a portable stove in her hand.
dialogues.text:
I realized that the board Mako's holding is the table from
yesterday. Moe-sempai also has a portable stove in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
まあそうだよな、いちいち持って帰ってたら、
大変だもんな――ていうか、目立ちすぎだ。
dialogues.en:
It makes sense. It's too much work for them to take them
back home every day.
dialogues.text:
It makes sense. It's too much work for them to take them
back home every day.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、組み立てるの手伝ってよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey Asakura, help us put this together."
dialogues.text: "Hey Asakura, help us put this together."

dialogues.jp: 俺の身体にテーブルが｛・・・・・・・／立てかけられる｝。
dialogues.en: She leaned the table against my body.
dialogues.text: She leaned the table against my body.

dialogues.jp: これを“手伝う”というのか？
dialogues.en: She's forcing me to help.
dialogues.text: She's forcing me to help.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、さすがに昼食をたかりにきた手前、働
かなければならないのだ。
dialogues.en: "Why do I have to do it?"
dialogues.text: "Why do I have to do it?"

dialogues.jp:
目の前には、ぐつぐつと小気味よい音を立てて、
鍋が煮えていた。
dialogues.en:
However, I guess it's a courtesy for me to help, since I'm
here for the free food.
dialogues.text:
However, I guess it's a courtesy for me to help, since I'm
here for the free food.

dialogues.jp:
そしてテーブルの上には、ポン酢と大根おろし
と錠剤が置かれている。
dialogues.en: The pot was boiling with an appetizing smell in front of me.
dialogues.text: The pot was boiling with an appetizing smell in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
他にも、萌先輩が持ってきたクーラーボックス
から、豚肉や白菜、えのきにほうれん草、ねぎ
や豆腐などが取り出されていき――。
dialogues.en:
There's soy sauce, grated radish and a bottle of pills on
the table.
dialogues.text:
There's soy sauce, grated radish and a bottle of pills on
the table.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、なんで鍋なんです？　別に手
　作りなら弁当でもいいと思うんだけど」
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai also took out some slices of pork, napa cabbage,
mushrooms, spinach, green onion, and tofu out from her
cooler box.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai also took out some slices of pork, napa cabbage,
mushrooms, spinach, green onion, and tofu out from her
cooler box.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は、きょとんとした顔をして俺の顔を見
つめる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai looked at me with a surprised expression on her
face.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai looked at me with a surprised expression on her
face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「冬といったら、お鍋じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Hot pot's the food for this season, right?"
dialogues.text: "Hot pot's the food for this season, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いや、そうですけど、なにも学園の屋上で食
　べなくても……寒いし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, that's right, but you don't have to eat it on the
rooftop of the school...... Besides it's so cold out here."
dialogues.text:
"Well, that's right, but you don't have to eat it on the
rooftop of the school...... Besides it's so cold out here."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私、お鍋大好きなんですよ。それに、お鍋を
　囲んでいると、心まで温かくなりませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"I just love hot pot. Don't you feel your heart getting
warmer when you're eating hot pot?"
dialogues.text:
"I just love hot pot. Don't you feel your heart getting
warmer when you're eating hot pot?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり冬はお鍋です♪」
dialogues.en: "I love hot pot in the winter time!"
dialogues.text: "I love hot pot in the winter time!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「答えになってないわね」
dialogues.en: "That's not a good answer."
dialogues.text: "That's not a good answer."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の呟きを聞きながら、とりあえず俺は具材
を鍋に入れるのを手伝うことにする。
dialogues.en:
I heard Mako's reply as I helped put the ingredients into
the pot.
dialogues.text:
I heard Mako's reply as I helped put the ingredients into
the pot.

dialogues.jp: 手近にあった春菊に箸を伸ばし、鍋の中へ……。
dialogues.en:
I reached for the corn marigold near me and tried to put it
in the pot......
dialogues.text:
I reached for the corn marigold near me and tried to put it
in the pot......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「待ってくださいっ！」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「な、なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "W, What is it?"
dialogues.text: "W, What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩のイメージからは想像も出来ない大きな
声に、思わず箸が止まる。
dialogues.en:
My hand stopped as I heard an unimaginable loud voice come
out of Moe.
dialogues.text:
My hand stopped as I heard an unimaginable loud voice come
out of Moe.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「春菊は、食べる直前に入れなければならない
　んです」
dialogues.en:
"Corn marigold must go into the pot right before we start
eating."
dialogues.text:
"Corn marigold must go into the pot right before we start
eating."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりにも真顔で言う萌先輩に、間抜けな声が
出てしまう。
dialogues.en:
I asked with a foolish voice, as Moe-sempai spoke to me with
a serious look on her face.
dialogues.text:
I asked with a foolish voice, as Moe-sempai spoke to me with
a serious look on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「まずは火の通りにくいものや、旨味の出てく
　るお魚やお肉を入れるべきです」
dialogues.en:
"You must first put the fish and meat in, in order to get
the broth."
dialogues.text:
"You must first put the fish and meat in, in order to get
the broth."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「は、はぁ」
萌先輩の勢いにおされ、箸を戻す。
dialogues.en: I put back my hand as I was swamped by her lecture.
dialogues.text: I put back my hand as I was swamped by her lecture.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「眞子ちゃん、しいたけ入れてくれる？　あっ、
　あと白菜の芯もお願い」
dialogues.en:
"Mako, will you put the shitake mushrooms in there? Oh, and
the hard part of the napa cabbage too."
dialogues.text:
"Mako, will you put the shitake mushrooms in there? Oh, and
the hard part of the napa cabbage too."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
慣れているのか、眞子は萌先輩に言われた通り
に具材を入れていく。
dialogues.en:
Mako put the ingredients into the pot as Moe-sempai ordered
her.
dialogues.text:
Mako put the ingredients into the pot as Moe-sempai ordered
her.

dialogues.jp: もしかして、萌先輩って鍋奉行？
dialogues.en: Is Moe-sempai a hot pot maniac?
dialogues.text: Is Moe-sempai a hot pot maniac?

dialogues.jp:
鍋の手順を仕切る奴をそう言うけど、まさか萌
先輩がそれとは……。
dialogues.en:
I've heard of hot pot maniacs, but I never thought
Moe-sempai was one of them......
dialogues.text:
I've heard of hot pot maniacs, but I never thought
Moe-sempai was one of them......

dialogues.jp: 人の性格とは不思議なものだ。
dialogues.en: People's personalities are full of wonder.
dialogues.text: People's personalities are full of wonder.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の指示通りに具材が鍋に入れられていき、
そして取り出されていく。
dialogues.en:
Ingredients went in and out of the pot at Moe-sempai's
instruction.
dialogues.text:
Ingredients went in and out of the pot at Moe-sempai's
instruction.

dialogues.jp:
鍋の中は良く整理され、整然と並べられた貝の
｛ふた／蓋｝が、パカッと開く。
dialogues.en:
It looked neat inside, and the shells of the clams were
starting to open up.
dialogues.text:
It looked neat inside, and the shells of the clams were
starting to open up.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今です！　貝を食べてください」
dialogues.en: "Right now! You have to eat the clam now!"
dialogues.text: "Right now! You have to eat the clam now!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 再び、マジ顔で注意を促す萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Once again, she looked at me with a serious face.
dialogues.text: Once again, she looked at me with a serious face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「貝は蓋が開いた瞬間が美味しいんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Clams taste the best at the moment their shells open!"
dialogues.text: "Clams taste the best at the moment their shells open!"

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩。眞子は表情を崩さず、
当たり前のように貝を自分の皿に取っていく。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai smiled, while Mako put the clams into her bowl
with a blank expression.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai smiled, while Mako put the clams into her bowl
with a blank expression.

dialogues.jp: 「頂きます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 貝を自分の皿に取り、中身を口に含む。
dialogues.en: I also took a clam and put it inside my mouth.
dialogues.text: I also took a clam and put it inside my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 確かに美味しい。でも……、
dialogues.en: It was indeed delicious, but......
dialogues.text: It was indeed delicious, but......

dialogues.jp: 「違いがわからん……」
dialogues.en: "I can't tell the difference......"
dialogues.text: "I can't tell the difference......"

dialogues.jp:
その後も、違いの分からないこだわりが続いた
のだった……。
dialogues.en: Her particular instructions continued endlessly......
dialogues.text: Her particular instructions continued endlessly......

dialogues.jp: ◆鍋奉行◆
dialogues.en: ◆Hot pot maniac◆
dialogues.text: ◆Hot pot maniac◆

dialogues.jp:
屋上で萌先輩たちと鍋を食べる。冬は鍋という
萌先輩だけど、なにも学園の屋上で料理をしな
くても……。
dialogues.en:
I ate hot pot with Moe-sempai and Mako on the rooftop.
Moe-sempai insisted that we must eat hot pot in the winter
time, but why should we eat it on the school rooftop......?
dialogues.text:
I ate hot pot with Moe-sempai and Mako on the rooftop.
Moe-sempai insisted that we must eat hot pot in the winter
time, but why should we eat it on the school rooftop......?

dialogues.jp: それにしても萌先輩が鍋奉行だったとは驚いた。
dialogues.en:
Anyway, I was surprised to discover that Moe was a hot pot
maniac.
dialogues.text:
Anyway, I was surprised to discover that Moe was a hot pot
maniac.

dialogues.jp:
ただ先輩の言うとおりに食べては見たけれど
……違いがわからん。
dialogues.en:
I ate it as she instructed...... but I can't tell the
difference.
dialogues.text:
I ate it as she instructed...... but I can't tell the
difference.
